item.title: moving on
item.description: i don't post here much any more, it's all on Instagram now and the app is easier. but i like this little pink room on the internet. i will leave it open. thank you for the notes ♥ [photo: night | last photo from the ninth floor. we moved to a new flat.]

item.title: river
item.description: [photo: river | the talas in spring. loud. you can hear it from the road.]

item.title: graduated
item.description: diploma! journalism, red diploma (almost red, one B in economics). i'm starting at a newspaper in september. photos and small news. very small news. a cat on a roof, a new bus stop. i'm so happy.

item.title: snow in august
item.description: [photo: snow | not really snow, the pass at 3,000 m on a trip with the photo club. it was snowing up there. in august.]

item.title: flowers
item.description: [photo: flowers | 8 march. the whole city smells like tulips and car exhaust.]

item.title: first roll
item.description: [photo: mountains | grandfather's Zenit, first roll. everything is a bit blue and a bit wrong and i love it.] 36 frames, 22 came out. the man at the photo shop said nobody brings film any more, he had to find the chemicals.

item.title: bazaar
item.description: [photo: bazaar | bazar-i kalan on sunday. the apricot sellers are back.] the old city before noon is the best light in talas. after noon it's just dust.

item.title: quote
item.description: "some days the mountains are enough." — written on the wall of the bus stop by the bridge. somebody wrote it in black marker in winter and nobody has painted over it.

item.title: tea
item.description: [photo: tea | grandmother's red tablecloth. she said "why are you photographing the cups, photograph me". next time, apa.]

item.title: first day
item.description: [photo: town | the university at 8 a.m., everyone in new shoes] second year. same building, new me (same me).
